false_pass_class_closed.why_it_survived_every_gate: A merge happens on GitHub. Nothing in the repository changes when it does, so every hand-written sentence keeps saying whatever was true the day before, and it stays PLAUSIBLE because it was correct until the merge. Phase status was right, every generated block was right, and all three workflows were green on master 573cf814 while three current surfaces still said the pull request was not merged.
false_pass_class_closed.additional_gap_found_while_closing_it: governance/project-state.json contains no blank line, so the whole document is ONE paragraph to any paragraph-level rule, and it contains the words 'AS AT'. The paragraph-level historical-marker excuse therefore excused the ENTIRE canonical state document. The stale current_maturity sentence was invisible for that reason, not because no rule looked at the file. Fixed by scanning JSON surfaces value by value: in a JSON document the unit a reader reads, and the unit a history label can honestly cover, is the value.
